title: How Trump meeting with Albanese turned the tables on Taiwan
description: The President’s statement that China has no appetite to invade Taiwan could be the beginning of a shift from a posture based on the inevitability of conflict to one of superpower accommodation.

title: Australia backs Pacific Islands facing China heat over Taiwan
description: Beijing reprimanded Pacific Island nation ambassadors for including Taiwan in the regional summit last month, but Australia and New Zealand have lent their support.

title: Cool: China Airlines Special Livery Celebrates Zootopia 2
description: This marks Taiwan’s first Disney-themed Boeing 777, which is scheduled to make its debut flight on November 19, 2025.

title: The U.S. Must Beware of Taiwan's Reckless Leader
description: William Lai is lurching toward formal independence, which could trigger a catastrophic U.S.-China war, writes Lyle Goldstein.

title: Taiwan in the Shadow of War
description: Facing China’s growing military and political pressure, Taiwan races to strengthen its defenses before it’s too late.

title: China Refuses to Congratulate Conservative Japanese PM, Lectures Her About Taiwan Instead
description: China insisted that its muted response to Japan electing its first woman prime minister, conservative Takaichi Sanae, was "appropriate."

title: China courts Taiwanese worshipers in religious charm offensive
description: Security officials in Taiwan are wary of what they see as a Beijing influence campaign using religions that are important to Taiwanese life but tightly controlled by the CCP.

title: Taiwan says China using religion to influence public opinion on the island
description: A new study has found that more than 10,000 Taiwanese citizens joined religious events in China in 2024 with Beijing’s backing. Taiwan’s government views these activities as part of China’s strategy to influence public opinion and expand its political reach through cultural and religious exchanges.
